summary: Paris, France, programmer, computer science education, strong interest in functional programming, expertise in Lisp and Emacs, interest in procedural generation and computer graphics (Houdini), strong opinions on software design and programming paradigms, active in online programming communities, interest in generative art and mathematics, critical of mainstream tech culture, values simplicity and efficiency in software, advocates for open-source and collaborative projects, expresses concern about societal impacts of technology, enjoys discussing philosophy and ethics related to technology.
